name: The Needs family of Heald's company, in the fort
head: needs_john

present_on_scene_date.note: The family's men, women and children are on Helm's and Heald's lists of 1812-1814 (Quaife App. IV, VI).

associated_with.note: No source says which room of the fort any soldier or soldier's family lived in; the barracks named here is the reconstructed choice (liberty L-1812-people-3461).

not_in_this_household.note: A child the counts of 18 do not name may have been of this family; those children have their own reconstructed cards (hh_garrison_children_unnamed_1812).

persons.name: John Needs

occupation.value: private, Captain Nathan Heald's company of the First Regiment of Infantry
occupation.note: His rank as the muster-roll of the company to 31 May 1812 (Quaife 1913, Appendix VIII) prints it.

present_on_scene_date.note: Presence on the afternoon of 14 August 1812, read from the evidence below; no source takes a roll call that afternoon.

persons.note: On the muster-roll of the company to 31 May 1812 (Quaife 1913, Appendix VIII), enlisted 5 Jul 1808 for five years, to 5 Jul 1813. An account of the battle or of its captives names him, so he was with the garrison when it marched. After 14 August: Formerly of Virginia; died among the Indians 15-20 Jan 1813 (Niles); wife and child also died in captivity.
